title: System part of the completed-coefficient direct-image comparison
statement: For prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $f:X\to Y$, fix a CoefficientComparisonData record $C$ and a normalized RightImage $T$ of the levelwise completed-module tower direct image, in the conventions of [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models]. Define StrictImageData f C T to retain only an additive direct image on the category of strict semilinear coefficient systems; its finite evaluation isomorphisms with identity sections; its normalized total right derived image; the Square comparing system restriction before and after the given tower image T; and the sectionwise identity of this ordinary square in every tower degree. This record contains neither tower evaluation comparisons nor any limit data.
